```{r}
save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/ENTSOE/outputs/final'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet')

capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
,"Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,"wind_solar_tot"                          
, "gen_tot", "Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity",
"Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"
)

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity)


```

Estimation after 2021 the REMIT publication policy




Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le modèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_real_published <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real_published, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

# perform first stage regression
m_limited <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity +Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_limited, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_limited <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_limited_published <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity+ gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_limited_published, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_limited_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_real_published, m_limited, m_limited_published, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real, cl_se_real_published, cl_se_limited, cl_se_basic_limited_published),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Predicted RF", "Predicted RF", "Limiting", "Limiting"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity","Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",'gen_tot')
)
 
```




With both for the post period to see any changes
I would like to see it on the whole period


```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity  + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_basic_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_all <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

# dummy for creneau
m_creneau_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity  + gen_tot +
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(creneau) ,
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_creneau_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_creneau_all <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_control_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_all <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_all, m_creneau_all, m_control_all, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic_all, cl_se_creneau_all, cl_se_control_all),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",'gen_tot')
 )
```

On teste l'égalité des coefficients entre published et unpublished pour voir si l'on peut raconter une histoire

```{r}
library(car)
linearHypothesis(m_basic_all, "Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity")

```




On s'occupe maintenant de regarder le intraday update

```{r}
first_stage_renewable <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
    filter(auction_before == 5)

save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/DATA/esp/renewable_forecast"
setwd(save_path_data)
renewable_forecasts <- read_parquet('renewable_forecasts.parquet')

first_stage_renewable <- renewable_forecasts %>%
  left_join(first_stage_renewable %>% 
              select(-c("gen_tot", "wind_solar_tot")), by = c('__index_level_0__' = 'datetime')) %>% 
  mutate(intraday_update_renewables = intraday_update_renewables/1000,
         unpredicted_renewables = unpredicted_renewables/1000)


```


```{r}
m_basic_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_basic_renew, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_control_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    wind_solar_tot+   gen_tot+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_control_renew, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_renew <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# perform first stage regression
m_renew_plant <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    wind_solar_tot+   gen_tot+
    Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month),
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_renew_plant, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_renew_plant <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

```

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_renew, m_control_renew, m_renew_plant, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic, cl_se_renew, cl_se_renew_plant),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",'gen_tot',
             "intraday_update_renewables" , "unpredicted_renewables", "wind_solar_tot",
             "Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity")
 )
```
